outcome: Area under the curve (AUC) around the gestational sac (monitored by CEUS)
cohort: The study included 23 low-risk cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients and 23 intrauterine pregnancy (IUP) patients, all of whom had a scar from a previous cesarean delivery.
finding: The effect of mifepristone in low-risk cesarean scar pregnancy, as monitored by contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS), was comparable to its effect in intrauterine pregnancy.
